data.body: AC amendment (gap analysis 1/5, CRITICAL): Reconcile resolver list with canonical schema. Schema (telemetry-event-schema.md) defines 11 common fields: schema_version, event_id, event_type, client_id, tool_id, tool_version, timestamp, pr_number, commit_sha, cycle, language. Task description previously included non-schema fields (workflow, skill, repo_slug, branch). CORRECTED resolver list: _resolve_schema_version, _resolve_event_id (UUIDv4), _resolve_event_type, _resolve_client_id, _resolve_tool_id, _resolve_tool_version, _resolve_timestamp, _resolve_pr_number, _resolve_commit_sha, _resolve_cycle, _resolve_language. Drop workflow/skill/repo_slug/branch. Optional fields (pr_number, commit_sha, cycle, language) when unavailable MUST be omitted from envelope per schema line 32 — NOT emitted as null.
